{
  "columns": [
    {"name": "emp_length", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.98, "reason": "Employment length is known from the borrower's application at loan origination."},
    {"name": "delinq_2yrs", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.98, "reason": "Delinquencies in the last 2 years are part of the credit history available at application."},
    {"name": "pub_rec_bankruptcies", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.98, "reason": "Public record bankruptcies are known from the credit report at the time of application."},
    {"name": "loan_amnt", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.99, "reason": "The requested loan amount is provided by the borrower before funding."},
    {"name": "funded_amnt", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95, "reason": "The amount actually funded by investors is known once the loan is issued."},
    {"name": "pub_rec", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.98, "reason": "Number of derogatory public records is available from the credit report at application."},
    {"name": "grade", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.98, "reason": "Loan grade is assigned by LendingClub at issuance based on known borrower data."},
    {"name": "home_ownership", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.98, "reason": "Home ownership status is self-reported and known at application."},
    {"name": "revol_bal", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.98, "reason": "Revolving balance is part of the borrower's current credit snapshot."},
    {"name": "inq_last_6mths", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.98, "reason": "Inquiries in the last 6 months are known from the credit report at application."},
    {"name": "dti", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.98, "reason": "Debt-to-income ratio is computed from declared income and existing debt at application."},
    {"name": "mths_since_last_record", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.97, "reason": "Months since last record reflects credit history up to the application date."},
    {"name": "mths_since_last_delinq", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.97, "reason": "Months since last delinquency is known from the credit history at application."},
    {"name": "total_acc", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.98, "reason": "Total number of credit accounts is available from the credit report at application."},
    {"name": "annual_inc", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.97, "reason": "Annual income is provided by the borrower (and may be verified) at application."},
    {"name": "sub_grade", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.98, "reason": "Sub‑grade is assigned at issuance together with the grade."},
    {"name": "int_rate", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.98, "reason": "Interest rate is set based on the loan grade and known when the loan is issued."},
    {"name": "recoveries", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.96, "reason": "Recoveries only occur after a loan defaults and collections begin, which is post‑prediction."},
    {"name": "earliest_cr_line", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.98, "reason": "The date of the earliest credit line is part of the borrower's credit history at application."},
    {"name": "installment", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.98, "reason": "Monthly installment is derived from loan amount, term, and rate, all known at issuance."},
    {"name": "addr_state", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.99, "reason": "Borrower's state is provided in the application and known before funding."},
    {"name": "funded_amnt_inv", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95, "reason": "Investor‑funded amount equals the funded amount and is known once the loan is issued."},
    {"name": "verification_status", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.98, "reason": "Whether income was verified is determined during the application process."},
    {"name": "issue_d", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.97, "reason": "The issue date is the loan origination date, known at the time of prediction."},
    {"name": "term", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.99, "reason": "Loan term (36 or 60 months) is selected by the borrower before funding."},
    {"name": "collection_recovery_fee", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.96, "reason": "This fee is assessed only during collections after a loan has defaulted."},
    {"name": "open_acc", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.98, "reason": "Number of open credit lines is available from the credit report at application."},
    {"name": "purpose", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.98, "reason": "Loan purpose is self‑reported by the borrower at application."},
    {"name": "revol_util", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.98, "reason": "Revolving utilization is calculated from current balances and limits known at application."}
  ]
}
